text:
Evan: Putting up a short thread — we need a commitment agreement + rotation plan for design-partner slots. Goal: run 6 partners over 6 weeks with a burn-in week and a rolling waitlist. Thoughts?

Maya: Love burn-in. Suggest slots = 3 sandbox + 3 integration, but rotate 2 every 2 weeks so we can expand feedback surface without blowing CS capacity.

Rajat: Eng constraints: prefer hosted variants; integrations require a 2hr onboarding window + one dev spike (half day). Telemetry minimal: event, latency_ms, route, feedback_tag. Example line: {"event":"latency_ms","value":210}.

Clara: CS can support 4 concurrent partners with weekly 30m check-ins. Rotation rules: partners commit to min 2 consecutive weeks, can swap out on good standing. We'll maintain a deque-based waitlist and call next-in-line within 48h of slot vacancy.

Evan: Commitment agreement draft: 1) 2-week minimum, 2) weekly 30m sync, 3) 3 async Looms over the run, 4) one 5-question pulse mid-run. Failure to meet commitment moves them to bottom of queue.

Maya: Incentives: $250 credits + a 60-min tuning session for integration partners. Keep it small to reduce admin.

Rajat: Add a regression/firebreak: if partner reports >20% increase in error rate or sustained latency >2x baseline for 12h, we pause and open a triage ticket.

Clara: Success signals: onboarding completion >=80% in 72h, weekly active sessions >=2, at least 2 actionable items per partner per 4-week period. Use Miro board for shared notes and a single Google folder for Looms.

Evan: Outreach cadence: rolling invites every Tue/Thu, 72h accept window. If no response we auto-reassign. We'll surface shortlist of 10 and apply a simple scorecard (fit, urgency, infra friction, responsiveness).

Maya: I'll write invite copy and the commitment one-pager. Rajat can drop the 3-line telemetry stub. Clara will manage the waitlist deque and calendar cadence.

ops-bot: Event created: "DP Slot Rotation + Kickoff" Thu 11:00 PDT (organizer Evan).

Evan: Action items: Maya: invite + one-pager by Wed; Rajat: telemetry stub + onboarding script by Wed EOD; Clara: waitlist tooling + initial shortlist by Thu. If no blockers I'll publish the plan Thursday morning.

Maya: Quick ask — include a short opt-out clause in the one-pager so partners can leave cleanly after 2 weeks.

Evan: Good call. Closing: I'll update the central doc and tag owners. Ping here if you need adjustments.
